cyberpunk_terms.vi: không gian điều khiển / không gian mạng ảo
cyberpunk_terms.definition: A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators, a graphic representation of data abstracted from banks of every computer.
The vast abstract digital network where data is visually manifested as geometric clusters and cyberspace decks connect.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: cao bồi bàn phím / hacker xâm nhập dữ liệu
cyberpunk_terms.definition: A data thief, hacker, or console operator specializing in cracking ICE (intrusion countermeasures electronics).

cyberpunk_terms.vi: bàn điều khiển / bo mạch giao diện thần kinh
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Hardware console equipped with dermatrodes used to project operator consciousness into cyberspace.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: băng điện tử phòng hộ / hệ thống phòng thủ mạng
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Security software programs that defend systems against unauthorized intrusion; visual representation resembles walls of shadow or ice.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: chương trình phá băng / phần mềm bẻ khóa phòng thủ
cyberpunk_terms.definition: A virus or penetrative program designed to pierce ICE defenses.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: băng đen phòng hộ hủy diệt
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Lethal countermeasures designed to kill hackers by triggering fatal neural overload or cardiac arrest through neural jacks.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: công nghệ mô phỏng kích thích giác quan
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Technology allowing a user to record or experience another human being's full sensory input (sight, sound, physical feelings).

cyberpunk_terms.vi: sóng não phẳng / chết lâm sàng trên mạng
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Electroencephalogram showing absence of brain waves; in the matrix, surviving an encounter with black ICE after flatlining is legendary.
The vast continuous urban megalopolis stretching across the eastern seaboard of North America.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: tay sai trẻ / đàn em bảo kê
cyberpunk_terms.definition: A young hoodlum, runner, or expendable gang subordinate in the urban underworld.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: miếng dán thẩm thấu dưới da
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Transdermal patch delivering narcotics, stimulants, or medicinal compounds directly into the bloodstream.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: vi mạch kỹ năng / phần mềm cấy ghép não bộ
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Silicon chips plugged directly into cranial neural sockets behind the ear to provide instant language skills, knowledge, or reflex boosts.

cyberpunk_terms.vi: bản sao ý thức / mô hình nhân cách nhân tạo
cyberpunk_terms.definition: A ROM cassette preserving the personality, memory constructs, and skills of a deceased hacker (e.g., the Dixie Flatline).

cyberpunk_terms.vi: khoang ngủ con nhộng / phòng trọ quan tài
cyberpunk_terms.definition: Extremely cramped capsule hotel room common in Tokyo and Chiba City ports.
A hub of black-market cybernetics, genetic engineering, and neurosurgery on the periphery of Tokyo Bay.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Relating to or based on mutual agreement or consensus.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Đồng thuận, dựa trên sự đồng thuận của nhiều bên.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Relating to an artificial device that replaces a missing body part.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Thuộc về cơ phận giả, bộ phận cơ thể giả.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: Ratz was tending bar, his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: In a dull, unchanging tone or tedious, unvarying manner.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Một cách đơn điệu, đều đều và tẻ nhạt.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: ...his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously as he filled a tray of glasses.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: A lack, shortage, or insufficiency of an essential substance or quality.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Sự thiếu hụt, suy giảm hàm lượng cần thiết.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: It's like my body's developed this massive drug deficiency.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Relating to coats of arms or emblazoned symbols; grandly or traditionally distinctive.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Mang huy hiệu biểu trưng, có tính chất biểu chương đặc sắc.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: In an age of affordable beauty, there was something heraldic about his lack of it.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere simultaneously.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Phổ biến khắp nơi, nhan nhản, có mặt khắp chốn.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: The ubiquitous presence of neon lights and sprawling corporate towers.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: The state of becoming obsolete or being no longer useful or in use.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Sự lỗi thời, sự thoái hóa và bị đào thải theo thời gian.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: Hardware condemned to rapid obsolescence by newer generations of microprocessors.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Relating to deep inward feelings rather than to the intellect; profound and bodily felt.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Thuộc về bản năng sâu thẳm, tác động trực tiếp và mãnh liệt vào cảm giác cơ thể.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: The visceral shock of transitioning from disembodied cyberspace back into flesh.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: The fact of two things being seen or placed close together with contrasting effect.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Sự đặt cạnh nhau để tương phản, phép tương phản đặt cận kề.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: The juxtaposition of cutting-edge neural tech with squalid back-alley clinic ruins.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Like a labyrinth; irregular, complicated, and perplexing in structure.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Mê cung, chằng chịt và phức tạp như một ma trận.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: Navigating the labyrinthine databanks of Sense/Net and Tessier-Ashpool.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: A countless or extremely great number.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Vô số, muôn vàn, hằng hà sa số.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: Myriad constellations of corporate data flashing in the electronic void.

academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.definition: Lasting for a very short time; fleeting or transient.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.vi_definition: Phù du, chóng tàn, thoáng qua.
academic_vocabulary_cefr_c1_c2.context_in_text: The ephemeral rush of synthetic endorphins flooding his scorched receptors.
